article.title: Summons to order defendant to produce documents relied on by him.
article.content:
7Summons to order defendant to produce documents relied on by him.

Order 5, Rule 7
The summons to appear and answer shall order the defendant to produce 3[all documents or copies thereof specified in rule l A of Order VIII] in his possession or power upon which he intends to rely in support of his case.

3 Subs. by s. 15, ibid., for all documents (w.e.f. 1-7-2002).
